messages:
Diego Morales: Hola team! Diego here  joining as ML Engineer (inference) today. Based in Madrid (CET). I code in Python, make a mean paella, and I collect goofy socks. Super excited. Quick: any recommended Slack rituals or channels I should follow beyond #eng-ml and #random? Also who to ping for monitor setup?

Ruth (People Ops): Welcome Diego!! :tada::es: We'll add you to the all-hands invite and the onboarding doc. Monitor/ergonomics requests go to @natek. Sign up for the mentorship program if you want a coffee buddy.

Nate K.: Hey Diego  welcome! Ping me here for monitor arms or standing desks. I'll drop by to set up your laptop later today. Also we have a sock drawer in the lounge for emergencies. :socks:

Mina Sato: Welcome welcome! For Slack rituals: weekly #show-and-tell on Fridays and the monthly meme-off in #random. Also subscribe to #infra-alerts if you want on-call flavor.

Diego Morales: Love the meme-off idea. :smile: And yes please Nate, an arm would be great. Also is there a good place to park a bike near the office?

Ruth (People Ops): There's bike parking behind the building  door code on the intranet. I'll DM you the map.

lunch-bot: group lunch options nearby: 1) La Taqueria (12:30) 2) Bento Box (13:00) 3) Pizzeria Olio (12:45). React with :one:, :two:, or :three: to vote.

Diego Morales: Voted :one: for tacos. Also tiny question: CA certs for corp VPN? I couldn't get a connection yet.

devops-bot: VPN enrollment pending for diego.morales@redwood. Check the onboarding checklist and run `sudo additionalscript enroll-vpn`. If issues, ping #eng-infra and @natek.

Nate K.: I'll help with VPN after lunch. Also FYI foosball is on Tuesdays at 4pm if you want to get annihilated by the eng team.

Mina Sato: Oh and bring your paella skills to the next team lunch  we'll trade recipes. :yum:

Diego Morales: Thanks all  see you in #eng-ml and at tacos. Looking forward to meeting everyone! :rocket:
